blocks.content: Removal requires an inquiry by the Supreme Court if based on misbehavior.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Removal based on charges of misbehavior cannot take place without a formal inquiry.
The Supreme Court is the constitutional/legal body mandated to conduct this inquiry.
The process ensures judicial oversight before any final decision on removal is made.
Competitive exams often test the inquiring body for removal on grounds of misbehavior; remember it is the Supreme Court.
Pay attention to the specific ground: an inquiry by the Supreme Court is explicitly required when removal is based on misbehavior.
